note: Plaza events at Meadow. Hours are minutes of the game day; an event can start from 'from' up to (not including) 'to'. Duration is game seconds.

events.name: Movie Night
events.pitch: A picture on a big sheet, popcorn, and whispering through the good bits.
greeting: Shh! The good part's coming. It's all good parts.
I brought popcorn. I ate the popcorn. Want to hear about it?
events.gold: Movie Night was a smash! The square is still quoting it.

events.name: Nap-a-thon
events.pitch: Pillows, blankets, and a competitive amount of lying down.
greeting: Shh. I'm in the lead. Don't wake the judges.
events.gold: The Nap-a-thon was legendary. Nobody remembers it. Perfect.

events.name: Yarn Festival
events.pitch: Mountains of yarn, a chasing contest, and absolutely no knitting.
greeting: So much yarn! I don't know where to start! Everywhere!
I've been tangled for ten minutes. Best day of my life.
events.gold: The Yarn Festival was a tangled triumph. Worth every knot.
